title.en: What mortar window does the plunger sprayer print?
title.zh: 柱塞式砂浆喷涂机印了哪一扇窗口？

description.en: 380 V, 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤ 8 mm, 100 m / 40 m, 420 kg.

h1.en: What mortar window does the plunger sprayer print?
h1.zh: 柱塞式砂浆喷涂机印了哪一扇窗口？

directAnswer.en: Mortar inside 4 m³/h and ≤ 8 mm, on 380 V. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the double-cylinder plunger sprayer at 9/11 kW dual motors, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg. It is not Type 311 and not a concrete pump.
directAnswer.zh: 砂浆在 4 m³/h 和 ≤ 8 mm 内，并且有 380V。邢台河北品锦机械把双缸柱塞式喷涂机印成双电机 9/11 kW、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、水平 100 m / 垂直 40 m、外形 1850 × 545 × 605 mm、420 kg。它不是 311，也不是混凝土泵。

heading.en: 4 m³/h sits between Type 511 and the 5 m³/h sprayer
heading.zh: 4 m³/h 位于 511 和 5 m³/h 喷涂机之间

body.en: Type 511 is 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 32/38 mm and ≤ 6 mm. The hydraulic concrete sprayer is 5 m³/h, 7.5/9 kW, ≤ 8 mm and 100 m / 50 m at 295 kg. The plunger is 4 m³/h, 9/11 kW, 100 m / 40 m and 420 kg. Match the output and the vertical cell, not the shared ≤ 8 mm phrase alone.
body.zh: 511 是 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、32/38 mm、≤ 6 mm。液压混凝土喷涂机是 5 m³/h、7.5/9 kW、≤ 8 mm、100 m / 50 m、295 kg。柱塞机是 4 m³/h、9/11 kW、100 m / 40 m、420 kg。要对照输送量和垂直格，不要只看共同的 ≤ 8 mm。

heading.en: No 380 V means a different sprayer
heading.zh: 没有 380V 就是另一台喷涂机

body.en: This page requires 380 V for 9/11 kW. The diesel mortar alternative at 3 m³/h is Type 511 diesel. The diesel concrete sprayer at 5 m³/h allows ≤ 6 mm, not the plunger’s ≤ 8 mm. There is no diesel version of this plunger printed in the catalogue.
body.zh: 这一页要求 380V 供给 9/11 kW。3 m³/h 的柴油砂浆替代是 511 柴油机。5 m³/h 的柴油混凝土喷涂机允许 ≤ 6 mm，不是柱塞机的 ≤ 8 mm。目录里没有这台柱塞机的柴油版。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send particle size and hose length. 100 m / 40 m is the printed limit. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送粒径和软管长度。100 m / 40 m 是已印上限。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Horizontal is 100 m. Vertical is 40 m.
answer.zh: 不是。水平是 100 m。垂直是 40 m。

question.en: Is the drive described as all-copper dual motor?
question.zh: 驱动写成全铜双电机了吗？
它能浇 2 cm 混凝土吗？

answer.en: No. The particle cell is ≤ 8 mm.
